title: 75 Percent Wireless Hot-Swappable Rechargeable Mechanical Gaming Keyboard
description: Lofree 75 Percent Wireless Mechanical Gaming Keyboard featuring a hot-swappable base for 3-pin or 5-pin switch replacement without soldering. This keyboard offers tri-mode connectivity (Bluetooth 5.0, 2.4GHz wireless, and USB-C wired), allowing it to link up to five devices including PCs, laptops, tablets, phones, and consoles. It includes a built-in 4000mAh rechargeable battery, RGB backlit customization, and a layered damping structure with silicone padding to reduce noise for a smooth, quiet typing experience.

title: BlackWidow V4 Pro 75% Hot-swappable Wireless Mechanical Gaming Keyboard
description: The Razer BlackWidow V4 Pro 75% is a wireless, hot-swappable mechanical gaming keyboard designed for full immersion. It features a compact 75% layout with 80 keys, including 2 programmable keys and 12 function keys. The keyboard is powered by Razer HyperSpeed wireless and 4K Hz HyperPolling, and also supports Bluetooth 5.1. It comes equipped with Razer Orange Tactile Switches Gen-3, an OLED display for monitoring PC metrics or custom GIFs, and a Razer Command Dial. Additional features include per-key RGB lighting with 2-side underglow, enthusiast-grade typing acoustics, and a magnetic plush leatherette wrist rest.

title: Womier Wk75 75% Wireless Mechanical Keyboard
description: This is a 75% wireless mechanical keyboard from Womier in a stylish pink color. It features hot-swappable linear switches, a gasket structure for sound dampening, and RGB backlighting. It supports multiple connection types including Bluetooth 5.0, 2.4GHz wireless, and USB-C wired, allowing for easy switching between devices. The keyboard is designed for ergonomic comfort and offers N-key rollover for efficient typing and gaming. It is compatible with Windows operating systems.

title: L75 Wireless Mechanical Keyboard
description: The Womier L75 is a compact 75% wireless mechanical gaming keyboard featuring an 80-key layout and a multi-function control knob. It is designed with a gasket mount structure and five-layer sound dampening for a creamy typing feel and a "thock" sound. The keyboard is hot-swappable, supporting both 3-pin and 5-pin mechanical switches, and comes with pre-lubed switches. It offers tri-mode connectivity via 2.4GHz, Bluetooth 5.0, or wired USB-C, powered by a massive 4000mAh battery. Additionally, it features south-facing RGB LEDs with over 16 built-in backlight modes and Crystal Jelly PBT keycaps.

title: K777 75% Wireless Gasket Mechanical Keyboard with Knob
description: The REDRAGON K777 is a 75% wireless gasket-mount mechanical gaming keyboard designed for both PC and Mac. It features a compact layout that saves desk space, a dedicated volume knob for quick audio adjustments, and a gasket-mount structure with five layers of foam dampening to provide a satisfying 'creamy' thock sound. The keyboard is hot-swappable, allowing users to change linear switches without soldering, and supports hardware-level NKRO anti-ghosting. It is equipped with north-facing RGB LEDs with 16.8 million colors and offers tri-mode connectivity via Bluetooth 5.0 (up to 3 devices), 2.4GHz wireless, and USB-C wired. A 4000mAh battery provides over 120 hours of use with lighting off.

title: C75 Hot-Swappable Wireless Mechanical Keyboard
description: The Memzuoix C75 is a compact 75% mechanical keyboard designed for versatility and customization. It features triple-mode connectivity, supporting Bluetooth, 2.4 GHz wireless, and USB wired connections, making it compatible with PC, laptop, tablet, Nintendo Switch, Xbox, PlayStation, and smartphones across Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS. The keyboard is equipped with hot-swappable sockets that allow users to change compatible 3-pin and 5-pin mechanical switches without soldering. It features PBT MOA-profile keycaps and a gasket-mounted structure to provide a softer, cushioned typing experience. This specific model comes in a pink and white color scheme with a cute, cat-inspired design.

title: B75 PRO Wireless Mechanical Hot-Swappable RGB Gaming Keyboard
description: The Lofree B75 PRO is a refined 75% wireless mechanical gaming keyboard designed for compatibility with Windows, Mac, and iOS. It features a gasket-mounted structure with multiple internal dampening layers (IXPE pad, PET pad, silicone mat, and sound-absorbing cotton) to ensure a smooth, 'creamy' sound and reduced cavity noise. The keyboard offers versatile tri-mode connectivity via 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth 5.0, and USB-C wired connections, allowing users to link up to five devices. For personalization and performance, it includes full 3-pin or 5-pin hot-swappable sockets, pre-lubricated reaper switches, and a multifunction knob. The design is completed with durable PBT keycaps and customizable RGB lighting, powered by a rechargeable 4000mAh battery.
